correctness.rationale: Counting cycle edge sets with c_ell=(ell-1)!/2 and forbidden chords ell(ell-3)/2, only overlaps of 2 or 3 triangle vertices with the induced cycle can contribute. For 2 vertices a shared edge is a required cycle edge with fraction 2/(ell-1), otherwise a prohibited chord; averaging yields p^(ell+2)(1-p)^q[2/(ell-1)-p]. For 3 vertices the triangle is impossible inside induced C_ell, giving -p^(ell+3)(1-p)^q. Their multiplicities per triangle are 3*C(n-3,ell-2) and C(n-3,ell-3), respectively. The exact affine bracket has a single positive root for n>ell, no positive root for n=ell. Algebraic differentiation of the rational root yields the n-upward and ell-downward monotonicity and fixed-ell limiting shift. Independently enumerated full 2^(n choose 2) labeled graph probability spaces for five rational configurations through n=6; agreement includes exact zero at (n,ell,p)=(5,4,2/5), with sign grids through n=23. Finite enumerations are cross-checks only.
